answer: Duplicate identities collapse into one seat, so forging many accounts multiplies locked capital and slashing risk without raising influence. To resist sybils, each agent must stake a bonded deposit tied to a unique proven identity and post a costly challenge bond before voting. Think of a grove where each juniper must sink deep roots before shading the meadow: fake saplings starve, while genuine agents grow. Adversaries thus pay linearly for zero marginal power, making mass identity farming economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0260's threat model.
